summary: Shakti Components Pvt Ltd (SUP-1008) experienced a Line 2 fire on 2026-12-02, halting production for an expected 48 hours. Two purchase orders for Bracket 501 (ITM-501) totaling 6500 units and INR 491400.00 are affected. Current inventory provides only 1.5 days of coverage at both DC-CHENNAI and DC-PUNE locations, and both POs will experience shortages. The supplier's production capacity and exact restart date are unknown.
facts: SUP-1008 (Shakti Components Pvt Ltd) status is ACTIVE with risk level MEDIUM.
SUP-1008 experienced a FACTORY_OUTAGE event on 2026-12-02 at 10:15:00 UTC with HIGH severity.
PO-1001 is for 4000 units of ITM-501 (Bracket 501) at INR 75.60 per unit, due 2026-12-03, with total value INR 302400.00.
PO-1002 is for 2500 units of ITM-501 at INR 75.60 per unit, due 2026-12-04, with total value INR 189000.00.
ITM-501 inventory at DC-CHENNAI: 800 units on hand, 100 reserved, 200 safety stock, 150 daily demand.
ITM-501 inventory at DC-PUNE: 1100 units on hand, 200 reserved, 300 safety stock, 600 daily demand.
SUP-2001 is a qualified alternate supplier for ITM-501 with 2 days lead time, INR 84.00 unit price, and 5000 units capacity.
SUP-2002 is a qualified alternate supplier for ITM-501 with 5 days lead time and INR 79.50 unit price.
